summary.text: Full Stack Engineer focused on building production-ready web applications with strong ownership from architecture to deployment. Experienced with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Firebase, delivering end-to-end features across backend and frontend. Background includes Web3 integrations (wallet allowance flows and on-chain automation) and maintaining SaaS products in production with real daily users. Experienced in structured AI-assisted development workflows and agent-based code generation to accelerate development and improve implementation quality.
